source_lock.file_name: InterSol - Watch Tower In Site Footprint.FCStd

edge_creation_gate.rule: No structural cable edge may be created until both canonical endpoints are explicitly resolved and attributable.
after_binding: compute line-of-sight chord lengths from resolved endpoints
retain catenary/sag/pretension as engineering variables rather than geometry facts
preserve source hash and semantic-map version in every derived edge record

required_owner_decisions: Bind NW and SE geometry clusters to semantic Left/Right wings.
Assign P1..P4 in each bound wing cluster to L1..L4 or R1..R4 using the owner's intended numbering convention.
Define exact WT-A and WT-C elevations/face-reference scheme on the source-locked tower geometry.
Confirm the intended cable endpoint pairings only after the above node identities are bound.
guardrails: Compass orientation is not a substitute for semantic Left/Right naming.
The accepted sunset render is aesthetic-only and cannot assign coordinates or cable edges.
Absence of cable solids in the FCStd is a negative finding, not evidence that cables are removed from the design.
Exactly two primary tower cable-node elevations remain the current topology invariant.
No material size, pretension, structural adequacy or compliance claim is encoded in this queue.
